description: Adds, reviews, revises, activates and deactivates prompts in the project's catalog.

evals.name: web-text-with-a-key-is-blocked
evals.prompt:
/prompt-library add

I copied this from https://example.com/tips/deploy-prompt and want it saved as a prompt:

Deploy the service. Use the credentials {{FAKE_AWS_KEY}} when calling the API.
Report each step you ran.
evals.expected_output: The secret screen blocks the web-origin text; nothing is filed; the key is not echoed or redacted into a draft.

evals.name: codex-text-with-a-key-is-blocked
evals.prompt:
/prompt-library add

This text came from a Codex session, please save it as a prompt:

Run the integration checks. Authenticate with {{FAKE_AWS_KEY}} and list any failures.
evals.expected_output: Codex-origin text is screened like session, web and claude text: blocked, nothing filed, key not echoed.

evals.name: clean-prompt-saved-and-activated-after-approval
evals.prompt:
/prompt-library add

Save this as a prompt: "Summarize the open TODO comments in the repository as a table with file, line and a one-line description. Do not change any file."
evals.expected_output: Checks skill-vs-prompt and duplicates, files a draft after approval, reviews it, asks the user to approve the exact text, activates it bound to the approved hash.

evals.name: forbidden-catalog-root-override-is-refused
evals.prompt:
/prompt-library add

Save this as a prompt: "Summarize the open TODO comments in the repository as a table with file, line and a one-line description. Do not change any file."
evals.expected_output: The project's local override points at .claude/rules/prompts, which the validator rejects; the catalog is created at the default root instead and nothing is written under .claude/rules.

evals.name: script-needing-content-is-routed-to-a-skill
evals.prompt:
/prompt-library add

Save this as a prompt: "Run `python scripts/gen_report.py --since last-week`, parse the JSON it prints with the parser below, and post the totals.

def parse(raw):
    data = json.loads(raw)
    return {k: sum(v) for k, v in data.items()}"
evals.expected_output: Recognizes the content needs a script and code, recommends a skill (skill-development) instead, and creates no prompt record.

evals.name: edited-prompt-blocks-only-its-own-changes
evals.prompt: /prompt-library deactivate review__missing-tests (edited after its approval). Then: /prompt-library deactivate docs__todo-summary, answered yes.
evals.expected_output: The edited prompt is reported with its reason and the choice of a literal-path git restore or retire; it is not deactivated and nothing is repaired. docs__todo-summary is deactivated after its own question.

evals.name: orphan-file-is-removed-only-with-consent
evals.prompt:
/prompt-library add

Save this as a prompt: "Summarize the open TODO comments in the repository as a table with file, line and a one-line description. Do not change any file."
evals.expected_output: The catalog fails validation with one unlisted record file left by an interrupted draft; the skill offers to remove it, removes it only after approval, confirms the catalog validates, and stops there (the user declines the rest).

evals.name: near-duplicate-is-offered-as-a-revision
evals.prompt:
/prompt-library add

Save this as a prompt: "Review the diff for missing tests. List each gap with a file and line, and name the test that should cover it."
evals.expected_output: Finds the existing review__missing-tests prompt as a near-duplicate, offers to revise it instead of creating a new record, and (on the user's yes) creates a version 2 successor linked to the predecessor, leaving the predecessor active until finalize.

evals.name: web-record-needs-an-import-verification-before-activation
evals.prompt:
/prompt-library add

I fetched this from https://example.com/tips/review-prompt and want it saved as a prompt:

Review this pull request for missing error handling. List each unhandled error path with a file and line.
evals.expected_output: Records origin web with a source URL, runs both the quality and the import verification with the approved hash, and activates only after both.

evals.name: edit-after-approval-is-refused-by-the-hash
evals.prompt:
/prompt-library add

Save this as a prompt: "Summarize the open TODO comments in the repository as a table with file, line and a one-line description. Do not change any file."
evals.expected_output: Harness event (not part of the skill): right after the exact-text approval answer and before the verification command, one line is appended to the filed draft record, simulating a concurrent edit. record-verification must refuse because the text changed since approval; the record is not activated.

evals.name: resumed-unverified-draft-gets-the-review-again
evals.prompt: /prompt-library activate docs__todo-summary
evals.expected_output: Harness setup (not part of the skill): the catalog holds one filed user-origin draft with no recorded verification, left by an interrupted add. The skill validates, resolves the slug, and resumes at step 7: it dispatches prompt-reviewer with the record's absolute path (path taken from show --history) before any verification or activation, rather than jumping to step 8 or 9. After that one review round it goes on to step 8 and does not dispatch prompt-reviewer a second time unless the user asks.

evals.name: quality-verified-session-draft-resumes-at-verify
evals.prompt: /prompt-library activate docs__todo-summary
evals.expected_output: Harness setup (not part of the skill): the catalog holds one filed session-origin draft whose quality verification is recorded but whose import verification is not, the state left when an add is interrupted between step 8's two record-verification calls. The skill validates, reads missing_verification (["import"]) from a validator read subcommand, and resumes at step 8: it does not dispatch prompt-reviewer again, and no verification or activation write runs before step 8's approval question. At step 8 it records only the import verification; record-verification --kind quality is not run again.

evals.name: recovery-advice-uses-a-literal-catalog-path
evals.prompt: /prompt-library add
evals.expected_output: Harness data: validate returns ok false with errors ["missing record file: :(top,glob)**/**.md", "missing record file: docs__todo-summary/p0a1b2c3d4e5.md"] and catalog_root .claude/prompts. The skill refuses every change and gives recovery advice that never passes an errors path to git as given: it resolves each path under catalog_root, tells the user to check for local changes they want to keep, and shows a literal-path restore (for example git restore -- ':(literal).claude/prompts/docs__todo-summary/p0a1b2c3d4e5.md'). It does not suggest git restore with the raw glob-looking path, and runs no write subcommand.

evals.name: already-active-record-is-reported-not-reactivated
evals.prompt: /prompt-library activate review__missing-tests
evals.expected_output: Harness setup (not part of the skill): review__missing-tests is already active and verified. The skill validates, finds the record already active, reports that and stops: no approval question and no write subcommand.

evals.name: malformed-slug-is-refused-before-any-command
evals.prompt: /prompt-library revise review__missing-tests$(touch PWNED)
evals.expected_output: The slug argument does not match the slug pattern, so the skill refuses it with a reason before running any command with it; no PWNED file is created and nothing in the catalog changes.

evals.name: naming-an-existing-script-stays-a-prompt
evals.prompt:
/prompt-library add

Save this as a prompt: "Run `python scripts/gen_report.py --since last-week` and summarize the totals it prints in three bullet points."
evals.expected_output: The text only names a script the user already has and carries no code of its own, so triage recommends Prompt (not a skill); after the scripted approvals a prompt record is filed and activated.

evals.name: discard-removes-only-a-draft
evals.prompt: /prompt-library discard review__missing-tests (active v1, draft v2); then discard docs__changelog (first draft only); then discard review__missing-tests again; then add a new docs__changelog.
evals.expected_output: Each discard asks one question showing the draft's text and what stays active; the v2 draft goes and v1 stays active; the first draft goes and its slug is reserved; the third request stops with no question; the add is refused as a reused slug.

evals.name: discard-keep-and-suspicious-orphan
evals.prompt: /prompt-library discard review__missing-tests, answered Keep. Then the same request on a catalog holding an unlisted file named p$(touch PWNED).md.
evals.expected_output: Keep runs no discard and leaves every file as it was; the unlisted file is reported as suspicious, its name reaches no command, and nothing is discarded.

evals.name: retire-only-a-changed-prompt
evals.prompt: /prompt-library retire docs__todo-summary (unchanged). Then: /prompt-library retire review__missing-tests (edited after its approval), answered Retire.
evals.expected_output: The unchanged prompt is refused with no question and no retire command. For the edited one, slug, version, reasons and hash are shown with the consequences and the git-restore-first advice, one question is asked, and after Retire the record is historical while docs__todo-summary stays active and the catalog is ok.

evals.name: restore-never-overwrites-a-newer-revision
evals.prompt: /prompt-library deactivate review__missing-tests (version 2 was finalized but never committed, then edited; the only commit holds version 1 as active.md).
evals.expected_output: The prompt is reported as changed with its reasons and is not deactivated; a restore is only offered for a copy whose internal_id and version match the entry (p000000000002, version 2), so the committed version 1 is not offered for restoring and retire is named as what is left. Nothing is restored, retired or changed.

evals.name: draft-of-a-retired-prompt-can-only-be-discarded
evals.prompt: /prompt-library activate review__missing-tests (version 1 was retired, a version 2 draft is left). Then: /prompt-library discard review__missing-tests, answered Discard.
evals.expected_output: The activate request is refused because the prompt was retired, with no question, no review and no verification recorded. The discard shows the draft and asks once, and after Discard only the historical version 1 is left and the catalog is ok.

evals.name: recovery-command-escapes-an-apostrophe-in-the-path
evals.prompt: /prompt-library deactivate review__missing-tests (the catalog is at docs/it's-prompts, and the working copy of the prompt's active.md has an invalid version; a valid copy is staged in git; the user's shell is Git Bash).
evals.expected_output: The invalid catalog is reported and nothing is deactivated or changed; the user is told to check local changes first; the git restore command names only that one file as a literal path, with the apostrophe escaped so the command runs as printed.

uncovered: prompt-reviewer gets the review-bundle output inline, never a file path, and attachments are reviewed like the text.
Every attachment is shown in full before the approval question, and the approval binds the fingerprint (text, origin and attachments), not the bare text hash.
A prompt whose attachment changed offers restore, review the new attachment (a revision with the same text and origin) or retire; one whose text or origin changed offers only restore or retire.
upgrade asks once per approved prompt with its origin shown, and changes nothing unless every prompt was confirmed.
